bodies.name: Sun
bodies.summary: G type star holding 99.8 percent of system mass. Source of light and space weather.

bodies.name: Mercury
bodies.summary: Smallest planet with huge temperature swings and a thin exosphere.

bodies.name: Venus
bodies.summary: Runaway greenhouse world with crushing CO2 air and sulfuric clouds.

bodies.name: Earth
bodies.summary: Only known world with life, liquid water oceans, and oxygen air.

bodies.name: Mars
bodies.summary: Cold desert with Olympus Mons and ancient riverbeds. Target for sample return.

bodies.name: Jupiter
bodies.summary: Largest planet. Great Red Spot storm wider than Earth.

bodies.name: Saturn
bodies.summary: Famous ring system made of ice and rock, plus Titan and Enceladus oceans.

bodies.name: Uranus
bodies.summary: Tilted on its side with methane blue air and the coldest atmosphere.

bodies.name: Neptune
bodies.summary: Windiest world with supersonic storms and dark methane bands.

bodies.name: Pluto
bodies.summary: Dwarf planet with nitrogen heart plain visited by New Horizons in 2015.

bodies.name: TRAPPIST-1 system
bodies.summary: Red dwarf 39 light years away with 7 rocky worlds, 3 in habitable zone.
